Alger, 19 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 19, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Mobile operator Mobilis unveiled a new application named MobilisTransfer this Wednesday. This digital service is intended for businesses and institutions to simplify the remote management of their fleet of professional telephone lines.
L'opérateur public Mobilis a officialisé: Public operator Mobilis has officialized the launch of MobilisTransfer. This digital solution is specifically developed for the needs of business and institutional client accounts. It allows managers to supervise the telephone lines of their employees subscribed to Revolution offers.
L'application offre une autonomie accrue: The application offers increased autonomy to managers, who can now perform remote management operations without physical intervention on each line. The tool aims to optimize the operational efficiency of professional structures as part of their digital transformation.
Le cœur de cette solution réside dans la: The core of this solution lies in the flexibility offered for the distribution of communication resources. Managers can distribute Mobilis Units (MU) among their employees' lines in a centralized manner.
Ce déploiement s'inscrit dans la stratég: This deployment is part of the operator's strategy aimed at diversifying its digital services offering. By proposing these management tools, Mobilis seeks to support companies in the daily management of their telecommunications while reinforcing the security of unit transactions.
Mobilis a lancé l'application MobilisTra: Mobilis has launched the MobilisTransfer application for businesses and institutions.
Le service permet de gérer à distance le: The service allows remote management of lines subscribed to Revolution offers.
